structured.feedback: The description is about 180 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the allergy complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the "includes everything you need" claim (the listing names only Probase), and the repeated "salon at home" phrasing.
